Hi Alicia — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) What we heard from you:
- Primary concern: PII/transaction-level data in prompts and model outputs, and whether any telemetry or logging could expose that data to third parties.
- Data residency: must remain in US for production workloads; dev/test may be EU if anonymized.
- Marketplace flow: you wanted clarification on what metadata is shared when customers provision via cloud marketplace (CloudMarketplace).

2) What Redwood provides today:
- We do not use customer prompt or output content for model training.
- Runtime telemetry (metrics, aggregated logs) is retained per our default retention policy (30 days) unless contractually adjusted; any logs that include PII are redacted by default in production (we can put this in the contract).
- We maintain a published subprocessor list; most telemetry is handled by our telemetry vendor (LogWave) and cloud infra (GCP us-central1) depending on deployment.

3) Attachments I promised:
- redwood-subprocessors-2026-11.pdf (current list + roles)

- I'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) after your security signoff to capture retention, redaction, and deployment region SLOs.

Thanks — I'll follow up with proposed meeting times shortly.

Hi Alicia — great questions. Short answers here, more detail in the attached MAP draft: 

- Telemetry: We do not ship raw prompt/output content to third-party analytics. Runtime telemetry is performance counters, latency histograms, error traces. We do capture structured logs for debugging which can include request IDs and non-PII metadata. For customers that require stricter controls, we offer a redaction configuration and can route telemetry only to our internal logging (no external telemetry vendor).

- Marketplace provisioning: When a customer provisions via CloudMarketplace we send minimal provisioning metadata (org-id, plan, provisioning timestamp). We do not send customer prompt or dataset content. If you require zero metadata flow, we can offer a private deployment flow or a marketplace flow with a marketplace-only tokenization layer. I'll let Devon confirm the exact fields on their end.

- Retention: Default telemetry/log retention is 30 days. We can extend to 90 days for security logs as a contract addendum, and we can add a clause to remove any PII immediately upon detection. We'll capture this in the MAP.

Proposed next step: Security deep-dive on Wed 11/18 at 10:00 PT (Alicia/Ian + Lukas + Neha + me). I'll send calendar invite. Attached is the first draft of the MAP that captures retention and redaction options.

Regards,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all — Devon from CloudMarketplace here. Quick note on marketplace provisioning:

- Fields shared to vendors during provisioning are generally {customer_org_id, provisioning_status, plan_sku, contact_email} — contact_email is optional and only shared if the buyer agrees. We never receive prompt or dataset content.
- For customers requesting minimal flow, we support tokenized provisioning where customer identifiers are replaced by a token that only CloudMarketplace can resolve.

If you want, I can join the security call to walk through the provisioning flow; otherwise we can provide a spec.
